journeys.goal: Create a contract from a vague robotics goal
journeys.evidence: The first action was visible; the brief detected one known skill and preserved eleven correction rules

journeys.goal: Create a contract for rehabilitation and fitness
journeys.evidence: The brief detected the health safety boundary without asking the learner to restate the request

journeys.goal: Accept one inspectable artifact and continue
journeys.evidence: Progress moved from zero to one of twelve; the next exact nodes opened automatically

journeys.goal: Understand why a later publication node is unavailable
journeys.evidence: The detail view named all three incomplete prerequisites

journeys.goal: Return after progress and feedback were saved
journeys.evidence: Progress and the selected feedback value survived a reload

journeys.goal: Recover when a primary resource cannot be used
journeys.evidence: The interface records a re-audit item and explicitly prevents silent substitution

journeys.goal: Select a domain and inspect a complete node on a narrow screen
journeys.evidence: The learner could prepare a request, inspect the four-lane dependency map, select accessibility, open the WCAG node, read its resource and acceptance artifact, and continue with zero page overflow

journeys.goal: Switch the complete experience from English to Chinese and continue learning
journeys.evidence: All navigation, instructions, domain names, node content, acceptance work, frontier summaries, and feedback changed language; one accepted node remained accepted after both language switches

journeys.goal: Follow a non-trivial public example from evidence to reliable publication
journeys.evidence: The demo exposes six dependency levels, four fields, twelve connected nodes, fifteen prerequisite edges, twelve whole resources, twelve acceptance artifacts, and thirty-six dated research directions

findings.observed: The detail column retained a 630 pixel intrinsic width inside a 390 pixel viewport and clipped both edges
findings.change: Reset the mobile grid placement; constrained the detail panel to the container; enabled safe wrapping

findings.observed: The first interface had no explicit action when a verified primary resource later became unavailable
findings.change: Added a local re-audit action; blocked feedback is recorded; the export carries the affected node id

findings.observed: The short Chinese hero title wrapped into an uneven three-line block at 390 by 844 pixels
findings.change: Added an intentional two-line Chinese title break and a mobile-specific type size

findings.observed: The four-lane dependency graph used a contained 768 pixel scroll surface inside a 390 pixel viewport, but the first mobile view did not explain the horizontal gesture
findings.change: Added a localized mobile-only swipe hint, a thin scrollbar, and branch-node scroll snapping without introducing page overflow
